newsitem.title: UK: LCE cocoa reverses lower, searches for direction.
newsitem.headline: LCE cocoa reverses lower, searches for direction.

text.p: Cocoa futures reversed to end softer on trade selling on Monday after touching a nine-session high at 987 stg a tonne, traders said.
"The market is looking for which way to swing...It is trying to find a new level," said one trader.
Cocoa futures had attempted to rally on trade buying earlier but just ran out of steam on trade selling at the close.
"The market was sceptical about fresh gains," said another.
At the close on Monday the benchmark December contract was off four stg at 979 stg after touching a session high of 987 stg - the highest since prices touched 988 on August 30.
Total volume on the exchange reached 1,801 lots.
Traders said they would be watching developments during this week's meeting of the International Cocoa Organisation in London but expected little of substance.
"I doubt there will be any market-moving news," said another.
